theorem_sketch: Prop 15.55: Assume G1=(n/2)1 and λ_max(G)=n/2 is simple. For |H|=2p with S_H≡2 on Max+, E[S^2]=4=1_H^T G 1_H. Write G=(n/2)P_1 + G_perp with P_1=11^T/E. Then 1_H^T (n/2)P_1 1_H=4, so 1_H^T G_perp 1_H=0. G≽0 ⇒ G_perp≽0 on 1^⊥ and ker G_perp=span{1}. Hence G_perp 1_H=0 ⇒ 1_H∥1, contradiction. Therefore no Max+-tight level-2 cover exists. Certified hypothesis λ_max=n/2 simple at p=5,7; FAILS at p=3 (λ_max=8>5).
